data.one_liner: Renders a markdown AST back to markdown string
data.what_it_does: Marker takes a list of markdown AST nodes and converts them back into a markdown string. It supports multiple markdown flavors and handles inline and reference links and images.
use_when: You need to regenerate markdown from a parsed AST
You want to customize or post-process markdown output
You are working with the markdown package and need a reverse renderer
avoid_when: You need to render markdown to HTML or other formats
You are building a UI widget that displays markdown
strengths: Supports original, changelog, and custom markdown flavors
Handles inline and reference links and images
Fully null‑safe and compatible with Dart 3
No build_runner or code generation required
weaknesses: Only renders to markdown, not to HTML or other formats
Limited to the markdown package AST
